definitions.explanation: The moment or period directly following an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{直後|ちょくご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}した→到着：02526_touchaku⟧。
examples.english: The police arrived immediately after the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧{直後|ちょくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}がいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to avoid exercise right after eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{直後|ちょくご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
examples.english: It started raining right after we departed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}が{覚|さ}めた→目が覚める：23498_megasameru⟧{直後|ちょくご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼんやりしている→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧。
examples.english: Right after waking up, my head is still foggy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直後|ちょくご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つながりにくく→繋がる：01963_tsunagaru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めておいた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}がいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Right after an earthquake, phone lines become hard to reach, so it's best to decide on a way to contact family in advance.

notes:
{直後|ちょくご} means the moment or very short period immediately following an event. It emphasizes how soon after — there is no gap.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- noun + {直後|ちょくご}: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{直後|ちょくご} (immediately after the accident)
- verb た-form + {直後|ちょくご}: ⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{直後|ちょくご} (right after eating)
- の{直後|ちょくご}: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直後|ちょくご} (right after departure)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧: immediately before (the opposite)
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: right after (slightly more casual)
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after (general, no emphasis on immediacy)

USAGE:
Common in news, instructions, and descriptions of sequences. Often used to highlight cause-and-effect relationships or sudden changes.
